value: A TYPED DENIAL WHOSE `expiry_check` READS THE POSTPROCESSED OBJECT OF A WEBFRANK-PINNED FUNCTION IS VACUOUS: IT CANNOT FIRE, AND IT LOOKS EXACTLY LIKE A DENIAL THAT KEEPS PASSING. AGENTS.md residual-work discipline 3 already states the mechanism -- 'fndiff scores the POSTPROCESSED object, so every webfrank-pinned function reads real 0 by construction' -- but it is written as advice to a lane READING a score, and nothing checks it where the damage is permanent: inside an accepted record's expiry_check, which is the one field a later lane runs INSTEAD of re-deriving. MEASURED IMAGE-WIDE at 3746773ff: 149 accepted records carry a `denial` block; 44 of them are anchored to a function that appears in config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json; 19 of those 44 name a postprocess-reading tool (probe.py, fndiff.py, savedregs.py, slotdiff.py, regnorm.py) in the expiry_check; and 13 of the 19 -- 68% -- omit `--raw`. THE NEGATIVE SIDE, which is what makes this a shippable REFUSAL rather than an advisory: six denials pass `--raw` to the same tools and are sound -- DoWorldAnimation, InitItemInfoData, fn_800DA6A4, getSinCos, cam_orient_to_80029E8C and CritterLineNodeColSub. WORKED CASE: `fndiff.py game/enemy/critter CritterGetTargetPlayers --count` prints `insns 128/128 lines 2 real 0` while `wf_word_diff.py` on the same function prints `128 insns, DIFFERING WORDS = 10, MNEMONIC DIVERGENCE = 0, PINNED = YES`. attempt.critter-get-target-players-clamp-merge.20260903.v2's expiry_check demands the baseline 'still read real 18' and it now reads 0; attempt.ES_...'s demands a multiset delta of `target-only +1 b / ours-only -1 fmr`, which is a MNEMONIC difference the raw body no longer has. Both are expired and neither could have told anyone. THE ORDERING FACT THAT MAKES A PROPOSAL-TIME SCREEN INSUFFICIENT: all three CritterGetTargetPlayers denials were written BEFORE its rule shipped, so no check at record-authoring time would have caught them. The screen must also run when a PIN is added -- adding a rule for function F invalidates every accepted denial on F whose expiry_check reads a postprocessed score. This generalises the single do_enemies instance recorded in claim.CX_expiry-check-sweep-six-denials-are-unrunnable-not-one-and-two-premises-are-expired.20260903.v1, whose queue asked for a savedregs-only screen; the reader set is five tools and the population is thirteen.
